mcpp.buildScript.diagnostics.description: Validate build.mcpp against the build API mcpp actually ships.
mcpp.buildScript.diagnostics.title: Enable build.mcpp diagnostics
mcpp.buildScript.imports.knownModules.de: Offer mcpp's own modules (std, std.compat, mcpp.*) in import completion. Hover still recognises them, and no import is ever reported missing, whichever way this is set.

mcpp.cache.warnAboveGiB.title: Warn above a cache size

mcpp.languageService.notifyOnDegraded.ti: Notify when the language service degrades

mcpp.task.cleanArgs.title: Add arguments to mcpp clean
